purpose: test whether bleed-aware capture-lane provenance improves causal live identity without forcing a speaker split
runtime_input_rule: candidate receives only runtime-visible ASR, production-planned units, embeddings, lane metadata, cross-lane voiceprint matches, and causal history; no reference/golden path

bleed_aware_mechanism.rule: flag a microphone-lane cluster as bleed when its runtime voiceprint matches a system-lane speaker; suppress or reassign that evidence to the matching system speaker; treat only residual microphone clusters as local-owned
bleed_aware_mechanism.naive_lane_ownership: REFUTED: microphone lane does not imply local speaker ownership

specimen.finding: all 15 bleed rows clustered as microphone ASR S01 while the single operator voice over-birthed as S02 and S03

preconditions: operator human audit complete for every gated case
truth-label perturbation leaves candidate runtime shape and decisions byte-identical
preregistration committed before first family run
splits and holdout opening-once guard frozen
parameter_budget: one preregistered pass; exact strength grid must be filled before commit

split_rules.validation: contains an audited hard class unseen during tuning
split_rules.sealed_holdout: contains the long case and at least one counterexample/control when count permits
split_rules.selection: metadata-only before seal; no transcript, metric, or reference inspection
split_rules.minimum_for_non_preliminary_label: must be set and justified before freeze

small_n_rule: if case count is thin at sprint hour 8, run under frozen rules and label every result PRELIMINARY-SMALL-N; no acceptance claim
